verdict.rationale: Omnara's own documentation shows users directing agents through conversation: sending corrections mid-task, queueing next tasks, answering agent questions, and chatting through the dashboard or a first-party Slack connector. However, the platform itself (agent setup, models, tools) is operated through YAML config, the dashboard, CLI, API and SDK, with no documented natural-language control of those functions. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of platform management (creating or configuring agents, models and access), an explicit description of a conversational command interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
Interact with agents directly through Omnara's dashboard or first-party Slack connector.
agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
